Bug_Title: BC: instanceof will always return false (BC_IMPOSSIBLE_INSTANCEOF)
Bug_Details:
This instanceof test will always return false. Although this is safe, make sure it isn't
an indication of some misunderstanding or some other logic error.
Bug_Explanation: This bug occurs because the instanceof operator in Java compares the runtime class (or classes) of the object on the right and the class on the left. Here, str is an instance of String, not Object. So, it will always return false for `instanceof Object`.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the `showBug` method, which contains a bug where the instanceof operator is used to check if a String object is an instance of Object. Since String is a final class and can't be a subclass of Object, the instanceof operator will always return false, triggering the bug.
